_doc: Revert-verify mutants for ticket 534a7a46, req 675cb0ab-b73d-4736-934d-6094e792af5d — SUBJECT: packages/core/src/services/GroundingExecutor.ts. Run from the repo root: python3 -I ~/.claude/bin/mutant-driver.py <this file> after setting `tree` and `subject` to YOUR checkout. Guards enumerated from `git diff -U0` (integration-test-revert-verify §A8). ⛤ ME3 is the gate's own mutant, required by the ORCH plan-gate: the ticket's property_set change is reached ONLY when scalarTypingForRange(range) !== undefined, and without that gate the shape guards inside needsYamlQuoting would quote a deliberate flow array on its leading `[` and break multi-class convert — so ME3 must redden K13/K14 (the verbatim axes) and leave the typing axes green. ⛔ NAMED, not mutated (§A35): the iriToObsidianName call in executePropertySet is DEFENSIVE — CommandResolver.getObsidianName (CommandResolver.ts:3696) already puts targetProperty in prefix__Name form with the same inverse, so on every resolver-driven path iriToObsidianName returns null and the fallback runs; no axis can distinguish the two, and an axis on the IRI form would specify an input production cannot produce (§A37). Probed 2026-09-20: a hand-built grounding with the IRI form does resolve the range, but its write key degrades to the raw IRI — a pre-existing defect of that unreachable shape, raised separately rather than adopted as this requirement's contract.

ME5_string_scalar_flag_forced_on_under_a._note: ⛔ NO DISTINGUISHING INPUT on this axis set, and that is stated rather than papered over (§A35): under a numeric declared range the declaration wins over the string-semantic flag inside needsYamlQuoting (the integer branch returns before the quoteAmbiguousScalars check), so passing `true` changes nothing for K12. It would matter only for a property that is BOTH in STRING_SCALAR_PROPERTIES and carries a numeric range — exo__Asset_label / aliases with an xsd:integer range, of which the three vaults hold none (that combination is nonsense by construction). The argument is threaded faithfully anyway so the two sites of this executor agree.
